title: AITA for not telling my best friend I was moving?
narration: I never planned to tell my best friend I was moving away. We had been inseparable since middle school, but lately every conversation turned into an argument. I got accepted into a college across the country, and I kept the letter hidden in my desk. On my last Friday, she found the empty boxes in my room. She didn't yell. She just asked why I trusted a stranger with my future more than I trusted her with the truth. I had no answer. The next morning, she showed up with two coffees and a playlist for the road. We still had a lot to talk about, but at least we finally started.
